reference_basis: UAF accreditation profile and internal certification procedures
Selected management system standard clause map
IAF mandatory document themes for audit duration, multi-site sampling, and ICT/remote audit evidence where applicable

nc_classifications.major: A nonconformity that affects the ability of the management system to achieve its intended results.
nc_classifications.minor: A nonconformity that does not affect the ability of the management system to achieve its intended results.
nc_classifications.critical: A situation contrary to legislation or regulatory requirement that may endanger human health or safety.
nc_classifications.observation: A positive or negative opinion about the management system that does not constitute a nonconformity but may assist improvement or inform the next audit.

audit_logic_checks: The certification recommendation must be supported by clause findings and objective evidence.
The reported audit scope, sites, dates, audit team, and standards must be internally consistent.
Major nonconformities cannot be left open when the report recommends certification or certificate continuation.
Minor nonconformities must have correction/corrective action expectations or accepted plans.
Multi-site or remote/ICT audit claims must include sampling or remote-audit evidence when applicable.

required_statements: Explicit statement that continuous improvement of the EnMS has been achieved with supporting audit evidence.
Explicit statement that continuous energy performance improvement has been achieved with supporting audit evidence.

required_elements: Statement of Applicability referenced or reviewed
PRP analysis and PRP verification evidence, not just a generic PRP mention
Hazard analysis evidence including hazard identification and assessment
HACCP/OPRP plan review with CCP/OPRP monitoring evidence where applicable
Traceability system evidence with a specific tested example
Verification related to PRPs and control measures
